reviewScope: 45 actual encoded frames, every 15 frames plus support boundaries and key anchors; full real-time playback not claimed
observations: Scale ruler remains present throughout the encoded plasma zoom.
Liver parent becomes translucent at its original site; same-plasma reticle persists while true-sized blood elements become resolvable.
Platelets bridge frames 6969-7029; the membrane/VLDL scene resolves at the same fixed focus while platelets leave the field and fade.
Labels remain legible and clear of subtitle and title areas in inspected frames.
Support boundary ±1 samples show no scene discontinuity.
limitations: At the millimetre-to-micrometre crossover, physical erythrocytes are necessarily small; the continuous ruler and same-location marker provide orientation.
reasonForReplacement: Later full-film motion audit found a pre-existing hepatic surface crossing at F6800 inside this patch range. Revision 3 adds local liver opacity control.
